calls.summary: Priya Raman, VP of Customer Experience at a healthcare payer, called to schedule a CX Assessment consultation for HIPAA compliant customer care outsourcing. Oscar walked her through the assessment scope and confirmed her channel volumes. He booked a consultation for the following week and sent a prep packet.

Daniel Okafor, a quality director, requested a QEval Platform demo to replace his 2 to 5 percent manual sampling. Lila confirmed his seat count and explained the AI scoring and automated coaching features. She scheduled a live demo consultation and looped in a solutions engineer.

Meredith Cole, a sales operations lead, called for a quote on outbound sales outsourcing and consultative selling teams. Mary reviewed her monthly call volume and the performance based pricing model. She booked a consultation to scope a pilot program.

Marcus Feldman, a new prospect from a telecom carrier, called to schedule a CX Assessment consultation for inbound support. Rosey collected his company details, contact information, and channel volumes across voice and chat. She confirmed the consultation date and set expectations for the discovery agenda.

Angela Brooks, a contact center manager, asked about Voice AI Agents for after hours support and human handoff. Lee outlined a typical 30 to 90 day deployment and per minute pricing. He scheduled a consultation to scope the deployment with her operations team.

Rahul Mehta, an existing QEval client, called about a speech analytics keyword report and his onboarding demo settings. Jennifer answered his configuration questions and updated the compliance flags. No new consultation was booked on this call.

Karen Willis, an existing client, checked the status of her back office onboarding for claims processing. Mike gave her a timeline update and confirmed the RPA workflow build was on track. He offered a follow up email with milestones.

Thomas Reed called to dispute a billing charge for extra QEval seats he did not recognize on his latest invoice. Sue reviewed the account and opened a billing review ticket. She promised a credit decision within 48 hours.

Nina Alvarez complained that the promised bilingual agents were understaffed on her account this week. Rose apologized and logged an escalation to the workforce management team. She confirmed a staffing review would be completed by Friday.

Gregory Payne reported an integration failure between QEval and his CRM after a recent update. Oscar gathered the error details and escalated to the integrations team. He set a callback for the next business day.

Sandra Kim complained about a delayed RTAA rollout for her onshore team after two missed dates. Lila apologized and escalated the deployment to the project lead. She could not commit to a firm go live date on the call.

Victor Osei called to cancel his speech analytics add-on, citing low usage across his queues. Mary started the cancellation request and reviewed the contract terms. She flagged an early termination clause that frustrated the caller.

Bernard Cole escalated an unresolved billing dispute over automation workflow charges from two invoices. Mike acknowledged the prior ticket had stalled and promised a manager callback. The caller remained dissatisfied at the end of the call.

Denise Frank complained that her Voice AI deployment was weeks behind the promised 30 to 90 day window. Jennifer logged the complaint and apologized for the delay. She escalated the account but offered no revised timeline.

Harold Simms reached voicemail after hours and left a message about a missed onboarding call for his quality program. He asked for an urgent callback and left his direct line. The call rolled to voicemail with no agent available.

prompts.question: Is the customer trying to solve a specific problem?
prompts.answer: Yes. The caller is a new customer interested in contact center outsourcing for customer care operations. They are seeking a BPO provider that can handle inbound support across multiple channels and want to understand Etech's capabilities, service areas, and availability.

prompts.question: What are the customer's expectations?
prompts.answer: The caller expects a consultation to discuss their company's current volume, geographic footprint (mentioned Texas location), and timeline. They want to know if Etech services their area and are ready to schedule a follow up discussion with a sales specialist.

prompts.question: How could the agent handle the call better?
prompts.answer: Marcus should have captured the phone number before closing the call to ensure proper follow up contact. Additionally, setting clear expectations around the consultation duration, next steps, and what materials to review beforehand would strengthen the caller experience and reduce no-shows.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Etech Global Services. This is Marcus speaking. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi Marcus. Yes, I'm looking into contact center outsourcing options for my company. We're in Dallas and we have a growing customer care operation that's getting too large to handle in-house.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's great. I'm glad you reached out. We work with companies across the U.S. providing enterprise contact center solutions. Before we dive deeper, may I get your name?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Of course. It's Jennifer Walsh.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Jennifer. And what is the primary challenge you're facing with your customer care operation right now?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Honestly, we're struggling to scale. We've got good agents but we're constantly hiring and training. The quality and consistency just isn't there. Plus we don't have real-time visibility into how calls are going.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's exactly what we solve for. Etech provides both the staffing and analytics capabilities so you get trained, experienced agents plus AI-driven quality monitoring on every single interaction. We call that 100 percent interaction analysis rather than the old 2 to 5 percent sampling approach.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: That sounds promising. Are you able to support operations in the Dallas area specifically?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Absolutely. We have capacity onshore and can serve Dallas and the surrounding Texas region. Can I get your email address so we can send you some information and get you scheduled with one of our specialist sales consultants?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Sure. It's jennifer.walsh at company dot com.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Perfect. Jennifer, how does next Tuesday at 2 PM sound for a 30-minute consultation call where we can walk through our capabilities and your specific requirements?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: That works well for me. Tuesday at 2 PM is confirmed.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Excellent, Jennifer. We'll send you a calendar invite shortly. Looking forward to our conversation. Have a great day.

callDetail.aiSummary: Jennifer Walsh, a new prospect from Dallas, called to explore contact center outsourcing for her company's growing customer care operation. She expressed challenges with scaling in-house hiring, training, quality consistency, and lack of real-time interaction visibility. Marcus confirmed Etech's service availability in the Dallas area, introduced the value proposition of AI-driven quality monitoring on 100 percent of interactions versus traditional sampling, and successfully scheduled a 30-minute consultation for the following Tuesday at 2 PM. The call was structured well but lacked capture of her phone number and setting of expectations around the pre-consultation materials.

comment.author: Kyle Paklaian
comment.text: Great work on this one, Marcus. You nailed the structure, paced the discovery well, and got Jennifer comfortable enough to commit to a consultation. One thing for next time, capture the phone number before hanging up. Systems can fail and voicemail is a backup. Also, before closing, spend 15 seconds telling her what to expect on Tuesday. 'Jennifer, bring a quick summary of your current volumes and your team structure. On our call, we'll walk through how our Quality Assurance and analytics work.' Sets the tone and lifts the show rate. Nice job overall.

qaPairs.question: What does Etech actually do?
qaPairs.answer: Etech is a full stack, technology-enabled BPO delivering enterprise contact center outsourcing across customer care, sales, quality analytics, and back office, powered by our in-house AI division ETS Labs. The best next step is a complimentary CX Assessment to map the right fit for you.

qaPairs.question: Do you offer onshore and offshore delivery?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, we deliver from seven global sites across the United States, Jamaica, and India, so we can scale onshore through offshore based on your needs. A specialist can outline the ideal delivery mix on a consultation.

qaPairs.question: Can you support HIPAA compliant healthcare programs?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, we support regulated verticals including Healthcare and Life Sciences with compliance monitoring built into every interaction. Let's book a consultation so a specialist can review your specific compliance requirements.

qaPairs.question: What is QEval?
qaPairs.answer: QEval is our call center quality monitoring platform that scores 100% of interactions with AI, speech analytics, and automated coaching, without the blind spots of 2 to 5% sampling. I'd recommend a consultation with an interactive tour to see it on your data.

qaPairs.question: How much does outsourcing with Etech cost?
qaPairs.answer: Pricing is custom because every engagement is scoped to your volume, channels, and goals, so we don't quote flat rates over text. A consultation with our specialist gets you an accurate custom quote.

qaPairs.question: How many agents can you provide?
qaPairs.answer: With more than 4,000 team members across seven sites we can scale from a small pilot to large enterprise programs. Let's set up a consultation to size a team to your interaction volume.

qaPairs.question: What channels do you support?
qaPairs.answer: We support voice, chat, email, and social through our omnichannel platform with unified interaction history. A specialist can map your channel mix on a quick consultation.

qaPairs.question: Do you offer outbound sales outsourcing?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, our consultative sales teams are coached on every interaction via QEval and have driven a documented 79% conversion lift. Book a consultation and we'll walk through your revenue goals.

qaPairs.question: What is Voice AI and how does it work?
qaPairs.answer: Our Voice AI agents handle conversational automation with human handoff for interactions that need judgment, and typical deployment runs 30 to 90 days. Let's schedule a consultation to scope a pilot.

qaPairs.question: What is Real-Time Agent Assist?
qaPairs.answer: RTAA surfaces next-best-action prompts, knowledge, and compliance cues live during agent conversations. A specialist can demo it for your use case on a consultation.

qaPairs.question: How long does it take to get started?
qaPairs.answer: Timelines vary by scope, and technology deployments like Voice AI typically run 30 to 90 days. A consultation lets us build a realistic launch plan for you.

qaPairs.question: Are you a minority-owned company?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, Etech is a global minority-owned business grounded in servant leadership with 23 years of experience. We can share our certifications and credentials on a consultation.

qaPairs.question: Which industries do you serve?
qaPairs.answer: We serve around 15 verticals including Telecommunications, Healthcare, Insurance, Banking, Retail, Education, and Automotive. Book a consultation and we'll tailor our approach to your industry.

qaPairs.question: Can you integrate with our existing CRM and telephony?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, our Integrations Suite offers 80+ connections to CRM, telephony, and WFM systems. A specialist can confirm your specific stack on a consultation.

qaPairs.question: Do you provide speech analytics?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, our Speech AI provides automated transcription, sentiment and keyword detection, and compliance flagging on every recorded conversation. Let's set up a consultation to see it in action.

qaPairs.question: What makes Etech different from other BPOs?
qaPairs.answer: Our differentiator is our captive AI and analytics division, ETS Labs, which makes every interaction measurable and every agent conversation actionable. A consultation is the best way to see the difference on your data.

qaPairs.question: Can you handle back office and claims processing?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, we handle claims processing, order management, and technical support backed by Document AI and RPA built by ETS Labs. Book a consultation to scope your back office needs.

qaPairs.question: Do you offer a free assessment?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, our CX Assessment is an honest audit of where you are and what you need across people, AI, and analytics, and it's often complimentary. Let's get one on the calendar.

qaPairs.question: What is the average agent tenure at Etech?
qaPairs.answer: Our agents average 6.3 years of tenure, which reflects our servant leadership culture and lower attrition. A specialist can share more on a consultation.

qaPairs.question: How do I request a demo of QEval?
qaPairs.answer: I can arrange a QEval interactive tour and demo with a specialist. Let's find a day and time that works for you.
